name: Pyroclastic Sphere Primitive
definition: A primitive that uses a distance function to determine location and adds a procedural noise value (usually fractal brownian motion) to the distance function. Thresholding or smoothstepping the final value creates a pyroclastic look with overhangs.
summary: The Pyroclastic Sphere Primitive is an SDF that displaces a base sphere with procedural noise to create organic, turbulent shapes, distinguished by its combination of low-frequency breathing modulation and high-frequency fractal Brownian motion.
